get.description:
Search open, de-duplicated, listed jobs by keywords and by meaning. Results carry no fit claims.

meta.mode says what ran: hybrid falls back to keyword when no job has a vector yet or the model is unavailable.
One listed job, open or closed, with its plain-text description and its requirements with character spans.

patch.description:
Grant or withdraw consents and change the time zone and the brief schedule. The person is the session's, never
anything in the body (T-3-01).

post.description: Ask for an archive of everything held about the caller. Asking again while one is being made returns that one.

get.description: The archive, opened from its seal for this one response. 409 while it is not ready, 410 once it has expired.

post.description:
Close the caller's account at once and queue the erasure of everything about them. Needs a fresh emailed code.

The Idempotency-Key is required (API.md 1.6) but not used to replay: the single-use code plays that part, and once
this has worked the session is gone, so a retry cannot get here. Nothing runs inside write.run for the same reason:
a wrong code must be counted, and an error raised inside the transaction would roll the count back.

Keep a resume and queue its parse: 202 with the document's id, and a Location to poll. The same key with the
same file answers with the first answer and stores nothing more. The parameters are checked in the order written.

file.description: A PDF or DOCX, at most 10 MB.

get.description:
How a parse is going and what it made. Poll this until status is succeeded or failed (Retry-After says how long
to wait). ?include=text adds the cleaned text the facts' spans point into, and its lines. Another person's document
is a 404, like one that does not exist.

post.description: Confirm, correct or reject one or many facts in one write: all of them happen, or none does.

Make this the person's hard constraint of its kind. There is one active constraint per kind, so this replaces
the one there is (the change log keeps it): to keep part of it, PATCH it.

A soft preference. A dealbreaker is stored as untyped_dealbreaker with notice not_guaranteed; when it fits a hard
constraint kind the answer also carries suggested_constraint, which the candidate may post to /constraints.

get.description: The change log, newest first: applied, declined and expired. ?status=proposed lists proposals still waiting.
The matches shown on a date, ranked, each with the requirement evidence table. Zero is a valid day.
One shown match with the posting's text (for the highlights) and a check of each hard constraint.

post.description:
Save, unsave or dismiss a match. A dismissal reason may propose a record change; it changes nothing until the
person confirms it through /v1/me/events.

get.description:
The decision ledger, newest first. ?job_id= returns the stored decision for one job, or checks that job against
the caller's hard constraints on the spot (no model call, nothing stored) and returns filtered or not_evaluated.
One decision of any outcome, with its evidence, the constraint that filtered it or the gaps that withheld it.
Past briefs, newest first: the in-app inbox. A day with nothing to say is listed as suppressed.

post.description:
RFC 8058 one-click unsubscribe: withdraws the brief_email consent of the person the signed token names. No
session, no cookie, no redirect; asking again changes nothing. A GET to this path does nothing at all.

BriefAction.title: BriefAction
BriefAction.description: An ordinary endpoint to call. A dismissal also needs a reason, which the person chooses when they dismiss.

BriefDecision.title: BriefDecision
BriefDecision.description:
One thing waiting for the person: a match, or the record changes someone suggested. A match nobody assessed
(is_assessed false) has no requirement table and no verdict: the search ranked it, no model has read it.

BriefDelivery.title: BriefDelivery
BriefDelivery.description:
in_app is the brief's own status. email is null when the person has not agreed to the email; otherwise what the
outbox row says: queued, sent, or failed (never sent: cancelled, expired or refused).

BriefSettings.title: BriefSettings
BriefSettings.description: How often the morning brief comes (BRF-03). Whether it also comes by email is the brief_email consent.

CodeRequested.title: CodeRequested
CodeRequested.description: The same for every address, so the endpoint does not reveal whether an account exists.

ConsentChange.title: ConsentChange
ConsentChange.description: One consent a person grants or withdraws in PATCH /v1/me. A grant carries the wording version they were shown.

ConsentState.title: ConsentState
ConsentState.description: One consent as GET /v1/me reports it. A purpose that was never granted, or was withdrawn, has granted false.

ConstraintChange.title: ConstraintChange
ConstraintChange.description: PATCH: what is not named stays. A constraint's kind never changes; naming another one is refused.

ConstraintRef.title: ConstraintRef
ConstraintRef.description: The constraint that removed a job. id and statement are null when the person has since removed it.

DocumentFacts.title: DocumentFacts
DocumentFacts.description:
What the parse produced from this file: facts the code could confirm, items it could not (kept as unconfirmed
facts of kind other, with the reason), and how many of all of them the candidate has not looked at yet.

DocumentHiddenText.title: DocumentHiddenText
DocumentHiddenText.description:
What was removed from the file as hidden or off-page text (REC-06): why, and a few samples to show the candidate.
Recomputed from the stored file, because the table keeps only the count.

DocumentView.title: DocumentView
DocumentView.description:
parse_error_code says why a document failed (or, on a succeeded one, that part of it could not be read:
partial_extraction); message is the same in words. hidden_text_flags is null until the document is parsed.

FactProvenance.title: FactProvenance
FactProvenance.description: Where a resume fact came from: the document, the character span in its text and the text at that span.

JobBrief.title: JobBrief
JobBrief.description: The job as a ledger row shows it.

JobCitation.title: JobCitation
JobCitation.description: Where in the posting the requirement is. The quote is the stored text at the stored span, never generated.

MatchJob.title: MatchJob
MatchJob.description: The job as a match shows it: the same fields as GET /v1/jobs/{id}, without its text.

MePatch.title: MePatch
MePatch.description: PATCH /v1/me: consents, the time zone and the brief schedule, any of them, at least one.

NewConstraint.title: NewConstraint
NewConstraint.description:
kind is a plain string, not the enum: a kind the matcher cannot enforce is 422 constraint_not_enforceable with a
suggestion (API.md 3.2), not a field error.

NewPreference.title: NewPreference
NewPreference.description:
value defaults to the statement for kind other and untyped_dealbreaker and is required for the others; weight is
required (-3 to 3, never 0) except for a dealbreaker, which is always -3 (REC-04).

PrivacyRequest.title: PrivacyRequest
PrivacyRequest.description: An export or a deletion, with the API's shared status words (API.md 1.9).

RecordCitation.title: RecordCitation
RecordCitation.description:
A fact of the Career Record a verdict rests on. A fact the person has corrected or retired since still shows what
it said when the verdict was made, with is_current false. source is null for a fact the person wrote herself.

RecordEvent.title: RecordEvent
RecordEvent.description: One row of the change log or the proposal queue. before and after are the row as it was and as it became.

RecordView.title: RecordView
RecordView.description: The confirmed record on one page. Facts waiting for review are counted here; GET /v1/me/facts lists them.
